description: Rolling LinkedIn content calendar (docs/LINKEDIN_STRATEGY.md §3). 2–3 posts per week, rotating pillars. Each slot is filled by a draft from marketing/content/drafts/ before its date; publishing is human-executed.
rules: Every post links to a checkable HydraShield page or an authoritative source.
No invented numbers, events, or engagement bait; evidence rules of docs/PRODUCT_STORY.md §8 apply.
Campaign-tagged landing URLs are used when a post belongs to a campaign.
